title: What's my archetype?
lines: The Hero (Sun), the Inner Child (Moon), the Trickster (Mercury), the Lover (Venus)...
caption:
What's your archetype? ✦

Astrology has read the planets as characters for centuries:

◆ Sun: the Hero
◆ Moon: the Inner Child
◆ Mercury: the Trickster
◆ Venus: the Lover
◆ Mars: the Warrior
◆ Jupiter: the Sage
◆ Saturn: the Teacher
◆ Uranus: the Awakener
◆ Neptune: the Dreamer
◆ Pluto: the Phoenix

Your chart is the cast you were born with. Ask the Oracle: what's my archetype? Link in bio.
